articles.summary: Fourth Quarter and Full Year Revenue Exceeded Expectations, with Fourth Quarter Revenue Up 17% on a Reported Basis and 12% in Constant Currency and Full Year Fiscal 2026 Revenue Up 15% and 12% in Reported and Constant Dollars, Respectively Global Direct-to-Consumer Comparable Store Sales Increased
articles.title: Ralph Lauren Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2026 Results Ahead of Expectations; Provides Initial Outlook for Fiscal 2027
